out_of_the_storm_task.interpretation: The execution receipt predates the later cancellation/update, but no matching repository side effect was found. This lane does not prove post-cancel persistence.

into_the_storm_task.interpretation: This witness confirms delayed/scheduled repository execution but does not demonstrate a side effect after a confirmed cancellation acknowledgement.

three_file_user_recollection.description: Researcher recalls one earlier ChatGPT scheduled-send experiment involving three files, a delay window, a cancellation request, and later transmission/materialization.

strong_case.finding: An older scheduled execution produced a Git side effect after the automation slot had already been reconfigured for a later trial.

evidence.finding: Reports described a limited test on some large Russian providers where TSPU blocked public DNS/DoH services from Google and Cloudflare for a bounded interval, with collateral-impact evaluation discussed by network observers.
A further network-specific DoH blocking episode was reported on mobile MTS in the Moscow region, demonstrating non-uniform provider/region behavior.

Human Rights Watch documented TSPU-enabled regional shutdown/isolation drills and collateral disruptions; it also cites a February 27 2024 nationwide disruption later attributed by a State Duma official to adjustment of TSPU settings, and January/March 2025 collateral service failures around TSPU changes/blocking.
OONI observed Telegram blocking across a large Russian measurement set while behavior varied by network; the report also notes experiments with whitelisting/CDN blocking approaches.

tspu_historical_capability.interpretation: The mechanism proposed by the researcher is technically and historically plausible in the limited sense that TSPU changes/tests can be selective by provider, region, protocol or destination and can create collateral failures. This does not establish offensive intent or an external attack campaign.

observations.finding: Russian network users reported new blocking of DoH/DoT to Google and Cloudflare with protocol- and provider-dependent behavior.

A technical test published Aug27 reported interception of open UDP DNS queries aimed at 8.8.8.8 and 1.1.1.1, returning synthetic NXDOMAIN while TCP DNS to the same resolver could return normal answers.

tspu_august_2026_parallel_event.importance: This is an independently observed Russian filtering/control-plane change in the same broad date window as the GitHub incident. It justifies a correlation lane, but not a causal merge.

github_causal_separation.reason: A GitHub-hosted scheduled event can be created entirely inside GitHub's control plane without a Russian client being online. Domestic TSPU filtering is therefore not a direct explanation for an 11h15m GitHub run-object materialization delay.
